one_line: Hands on the product at 0:00, quick top-down cuts, and one held shot of the finished object.

q1_hook.what: 0:00 top-down on a white table: a child's hand reaches over three Giotto marker boxes (Turbo Maxi Fluo, Candy collection, Turbo Glitter). 0:02 a wooden tray of markers. No speech (transcript only "תודה רבה"), no text.
q1_hook.why: The product is on screen and being handled at 0:00, and a cut at 1.2 s keeps it moving (S1, E1). But nothing says what will be made, so a viewer only learns at 0:30 (H2). With no voice and no text, the hook has nothing to hear or read (H6).

beats.what: A child's hand over three Giotto boxes, then into a wooden tray of markers
beats.why: Colour and a hand in motion

beats.what: Child draws a bunny stick figure in black marker, adds red hatching and purple
A cat figure outlined, coloured blue and red; an adult hand writes on a sign; a green shape
beats.why: More figures, a new picture each cut

beats.what: Neon and glitter markers on more figures; at 0:21 two ink-stained hands held up
beats.why: A funny, real sign of heavy use

beats.what: Cut-out figures spread on the table beside the tray and scissors
beats.why: Hints at what the drawings become

beats.what: An adult hand with a green hole punch, a bamboo stick, a ball of white thread
The finished mobile of drawn figures hangs by a wall, then in front of a window
beats.why: The reveal, held for about 5 s

q2_flow.interaction_prompts: None. The caption makes statements only: no question, comment word, save, send or tag ask.
q2_flow.why: A cut about every 1.5 s keeps something new on screen (R3, E2). The question of what the drawings become is answered only at 0:30, with the finished mobile held at the end (H5, R4). The ink-stained hands add a relatable, funny beat (K3). 36 s fits one craft (R2).

q3_cta.what: None in the video. The caption has statements only ("והחלטנו להשתמש בהם ליצירת מובייל ארנבים 🐰") and the tag @giotto_israel. No link, code, question or ask.
q3_cta.why: The sell is very light (C7, C1), which fits a craft Reel. The cost is no next step: no way to find the markers, no save or send prompt, though the idea is worth saving (R7).

q4_shown.what: Giotto boxes and a marker tray 0:00 to 0:04, then in the corner of later shots; a child's hand drawing and colouring; ink-stained hands at 0:21; cut-outs; an adult hand with hole punch, stick, thread; the finished mobile 0:30 to 0:36. No face, no price.
q4_shown.why: The markers are handled from 0:00 (S1). The brand sits on boxes and markers throughout, never on a logo card, a light repeated pulse (H3). Hands only carry it, with no child's face (S4, S5). The stained hands and the finished mobile are the proof.

q5_edit.what: 23 shots in 35.7 s, about 1.5 s each; straight cuts about every 1 to 2 s, all top-down until the last two shots. No speed changes seen. No text, no speech. The finished mobile is held for about 5 s at the end.
q5_edit.why: A cut by 1.2 s opens with motion (E1). Cuts are quicker than the 2 to 5 s guide but stay in one scene (E2). It ends on the payoff with no tail (E8). With no speech or text, the edit carries no message for any viewer (E4).

q6_topic.what: A bunny mobile made from a child's marker drawings; serves a parent wanting a keepsake craft to do with a child.
q6_topic.why: Draw, cut, hang, then a finished object is a small story with a payoff (K2). The mess on the hands is a relatable family moment (K3). The mood is calm and warm, not high arousal (K1). A craft idea is something to send to another parent (R5).

q7_filmed.what: Phone handheld above a white table in daylight: a small child's hand, then an adult hand with a ring; close-ups of the marker tray; the finished mobile filmed at a low angle against a wall, then a bright window with blinds.
q7_filmed.why: Top-down hands put the viewer in the maker's seat (F5), and drawings and markers fill the frame (F4). All live motion (F8). It is homemade and sharp, but the last shot against the window is backlit and low in contrast (F7).

q8_text.on_screen: None: no headline, no subtitles, no labels, no CTA. The only words are printed on the boxes and markers (GIOTTO TURBO MAXI FLUO, Candy collection, TURBO GLITTER) and a small Hebrew sign on a drawing, too small to read.
q8_text.caption: "מובייל זה פורמט שאני מאוד אוהבת, תמיד מרגישה שהוא מאפשר לי לספר סיפור." About 30 words: a personal line, "קיבלנו חבילה משמחת עם טושים איכותיים של @giotto_israel", the idea of a bunny mobile. No hashtags, no ask.
q8_text.why: With no text and no speech, the caption is the only carrier of what is being made, so the Reel says nothing on its own (T1, T3). It has no hashtags and no parent search words (T7). "קיבלנו חבילה" says gifts in plain words, but there is no partnership word or label (T8).

weak_points: Nothing says what is being made or why until 0:30; no voice, text, hashtags or ask; a backlit final shot; the gifted-package wording is soft.
lumebook_takeaway: Prop the phone above a table: hands handling the product at 0:00, quick top-down cuts of the making, ending on the finished piece held for 5 s.
not_verified: Music (transcript only "תודה רבה", no speech evident). Who did the cutting and hanging (an adult hand appears at 0:14 and 0:26 to 0:29). Whose hands are held up at 0:21. What the Hebrew on the small sign says. Correction to coded file: the finished mobile is held for about 5 s (0:30 to 0:36), not the last 3 s.
